cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds a smartphone at chest height; a quiet indoor ice rink during an empty early-morning public session — she rests at the open rink gate; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing; her home kitchen with a counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; an empty art-deco cinema foyer after a retro costume screening — wearing a playful adult cinema-usher party costume she sits down to cool off and peels off the costume's detachable overskirt; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing with one foot up on a step; a fashion runway under white spotlights — sitting on the ground; a misty enchanted garden of moss — lying on her left side; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds a cup in both hands; a street food stall at night under a tarp — eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing
